title: Saving a text style leaves the Text section without a Size menu
goal: Two walks that save a text style and then reach for the Size menu find no Size menu in the window at all. If that is what a person sees too, the Text controls disappear after saving a style, which would be a plain bug in the most ordinary path through styles.
notes: Reproduced on a CLEAN checkout of main (1c851abe, my own changes stashed), so it is not from the copy-own-text-style work: `git stash -u && Scripts/playtest-all.sh text-style-walk` -> `text-style-walk 18s FAILED step 58 (panelMenu): no menu called "Size" is in the window; the ones that are: 100% 58.0pt wide at x 869.0 says "Choose a zoom level. Double click for actual size"`. text-style-arming-walk fails the same way at its step 48. The other three text-style walks (drag, row-drop, comes-away) pass. Both failing steps come after a Save as Style, so the first thing to check is whether the selection or the Text section survives saving.
acceptance: Whatever the walks were waiting for is either present in the panel or the walks say plainly why it is not
